run_draw_rotating_geometry: run draw_rotating_geometry to render an orbiting camera view of a 3D mesh and save frames as images
run_create_video: run create_video to encode a directory of JPG frames into an MP4 video using FFmpeg
run_get_last_folders: run get_last_folders to recursively find leaf directories containing exactly one OBJ mesh file
run_main_mesh_viz: run the main block to auto-find final mesh OBJ files and generate rotating visualization videos
run_get_int: run get_int to extract the numeric prefix from a filename string for sorting image frames
